name: Enterfind Server Dev Container
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'echo "Starting services..." && echo "Starting PostgreSQL..." && sudo service postgresql status > /dev/null 2>&1 || sudo service postgresql start && echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..." && sleep 2 && for i in {1..30}; do pg_isready -U postgres > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "PostgreSQL ready" && break; sleep 1; done && echo "Initializing test database..." && sudo -u postgres psql -f .devcontainer/init-test-db.sql 2>/dev/null || echo "Test database already exists" && echo "Starting Samba..." && /usr/local/bin/start-samba.sh && echo "Waiting for Samba..." && sleep 2 && for i in {1..10}; do pgrep -f smbd > /dev/null && echo "Samba ready" && break; sleep 1; done && echo "Starting MinIO..." && /usr/local/bin/start-minio.sh && echo "Waiting for MinIO..." && sleep 2 && for i in {1..15}; do curl -sf http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "MinIO ready" && break; sleep 1; done'
